entities.summary: Maria Fjodorovna Zibold, also known as Marie Siebold (1849–1939) was a Russo-Serbian physician. Born in Saint Petersburg, she studied in Zürich and Bern from 1870 to 1874 and qualified in 1874. She first obtained recognition as a surgeon in a military hospital in Serbia during the Russo-Turkish War and then practiced in Belgrade from 1878 to 1888. Exiled for safety reasons, she was active in Constantinople for 17 years, until a harem intrigue led to her expulsion. After unsuccessful practice in Belgrade, she was active in Egyptian hospitals from 1907.
